title: Conditional kappa 0.001000220224856110: six fixed levels on #390
body:
Conditional **κ = 0.001000220224856110** (`100022022485611/10^17`), exactly `983291/(5*10^17)` = **1.966582e-12 above #390**. This is a small finite-bootstrap and arithmetic refinement of Dugongue's new supplier, with **no circuit, bank, helper, fallback or physical-invoice change**.

The branch builds on #390 at `0e790f2dfb64e17bdee154aee151bb0c1dddb28e`, plus `research/e8-prefix-bootstrap/` and its workflow. Its packaging is repaired: #390 committed a `pr352.rar` in place of 104 files required by its own manifest. This branch restores those exact SHA-256-pinned files from the prior supplier snapshots and removes the unlisted archive from the package. All 296 source files and the original manifest now match the intended source bytes; no supplier code or mathematical value is changed. All target-prefix, dirty-preconditioning and heterogeneous-bank gains belong to #390 and its credited contributors. This does not claim those mechanisms as new work here.

The same paid complex profile is enclosed by two independent rational moment engines between `0.001001221667017025386926` and `0.001001221667017025386927`. The full positive `10^-16` fallback remains. Our #387 fixed-depth extension of the reviewed #185 mechanism uses exactly six acyclic ordinary-bootstrap levels, beta=eta=`10^-18`, and saving `(1-beta)*b-10^-24`. Every level has positive atom, borrowing, remainder and stock gaps with an explicit finite-cutoff formula for any fixed dominating constant.

All **47 strict outer inequalities**, six invalid-parameter/cutoff controls, both exact moment enclosures, and the strict next-grid ceiling pass locally. Even the certified upper moment root u satisfies `u/(1+u) < κ+10^-18`; extra root digits or bootstrap levels alone cannot reach the next tick in this formula and paid profile.

**Validation completed on Python 3.11 and 3.14:** [GitHub Actions run 38121315906](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38121315906) passes at commit `ac55c57035c197f744390fe4bc9cf49df1b61816`. Both saved `RESULT.json` artifacts report `PASS_FULL_PR390_REPLAY_AND_FINITE_BOOTSTRAP`: all twelve #390 stages ran afresh, the emitted profile and finite invoice matched, both exact moment engines agreed, all 47 strict outer constraints passed, and all six invalid-parameter/cutoff controls were rejected. Both runs certify the stated κ and strict next-grid ceiling. Expected records were compared only after execution; they did not replace it.

The initial source-integrity failures are resolved by restoring the 104 missing manifest-pinned supplier files described above. Every upstream byte is checked before and after execution. All 58 GitHub checks pass at this commit, including the broader repository matrix. Full CI artifacts preserve the replay outputs and logs.

Reproduce with the unchanged #390 dependencies:

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/e8-prefix-restoration/requirements.txt
python -B research/e8-prefix-bootstrap/verify.py /fresh/output
```

Requires C++17 and Boost headers as #390 does. The three joint-dual metadata files carry the previously verified #318 source-pin repair without changing mathematical values.

**Scope:** finite conditional witness. All #390 all-size local-identity, compiler, arbitrary-dirty banking, owner-route, fixed-tape, common-grid, precision/recovery, restored-row, nine-centre bit, degree-two and analytic interfaces remain assumptions. The prior #185 review covered three levels; the new six-level extension is stated here with its completed-leaf and spectator conditions. No new Lean theorem, unconditional multiplication bound, measured primitive constants or runtime improvement is claimed.

Prepared by Rohan Arun with OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; original source licenses are retained.
